text: The Code Review Platform fills the void left by legacy reviews conducted without common standards, because a compendium of reviews generates a common standard that guides reviewers and the collective toward shared expectations on functionality and quality outcomes.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning (2024). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=4755632

isBasedOn.name: AI Learning - Decentralized Governance to Optimize Human Output Datasets for AI Learning

abstract: The Code Review Platform creates a compendium of reviews and through it a common standard for code reviews

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: applies where a collective reviews code under a common set of standards
